title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 113 (Fort St. John Sewage Lagoons)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Fort St. John Sewage Lagoons
113 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in M.U. 7-33 being the Northeast 1/4 of Section 19, Township 83, Range 18, West of the 6th Meridian; and the Southwest 1/4 of Section 30, Township 83, Range 18, West of the 6th Meridian. [en. B.C. Reg. 224/92, s. 12.]
